ICS 91.100.30CED 5Revised Standard from Last Update.1. ScopeThis standard covers the laying, finishing and maintenance of cement concrete tiles in floors, walls, staircases, pavings, etc.2. ReferencesThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards aresubject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
